shot.description: A rain-drenched racetrack at midnight, covered in puddles on gritty asphalt reflecting the neon lights in their reflections. Overhead stadium lights pierce through a heavy downpour, reflecting off a massive puddles in the dark, dramatic night. Fog obscures details in the distance. Rainy and dark and dramatic night time with billowing thunderhead clouds and deep blue shadows. @tommy walks in pro
